review_evidence: README identifies the repository as worked solutions to exercises from the Imperial Formalising Mathematics course in Lean 4.
Its 52 primary files cover logic, real-number algebra and inequalities, limits, functions, and later course topics as completed formal proofs rather than blank templates.
Solution proofs are independently useful formal prior art even when exercise statements originate elsewhere; exact duplicate handling is delegated to the corpus duplicate machinery.
summary: Retain ExFormMathL4 as a collection of completed Lean 4 solutions to formal mathematics exercises across multiple topics.
